source: Re-encode the authoritative binary labels at one bit per sample, using the same sample chunk boundaries. Commit the compressed chunk hashes in a trusted preparation receipt. Preserve the same window starts, questions, comparison oracle, and application cache policy.

policies.cold: Read a packed source chunk on its first scan visit and verify its hash.
policies.eager: Allow saved two-plane blocks to seed bounds even if an individual block costs more than a packed source chunk. Skip the seed pass whenever its total saved payload cannot beat the packed cold full-scan footprint.
policies.guarded: Choose saved observations only if a complete block costs less than the corresponding full source chunk. Apply the known encoding size rule before reading the compact index or opening evidence blocks.

criterion: Check all answers against the independent shifted-window counts. Compare payload bytes and additional compact index metadata. Report whether any within-question payload wins survive alongside the batch cost, and test refusal of a damaged packed source chunk.
